description: Immutable threshold manifest for PERF-SCALE-001 100k representative benchmark. Fix before run; do not relax after run. Target 2 GiB Muzilla-owned RSS (Docker Engine/OS cache excluded). SSD baseline. Any increase above 2 GiB requires bottleneck evidence and documented trade-off.

hardware_baseline.notes: Recorded at manifest creation; exact benchmark hardware recorded again in result JSON. SSD is baseline; HDD/NAS not required for initial gate.

dataset.distribution: 50/50 album/singleton, multidisc 7%, compilation 6%, embedded art 10%, realistic-audio 2%, Unicode/case 4%/3%, sparse 30%, inconsistent 5%, ambiguous title 2%, near-duplicate via limited title words
dataset.source_fixture: tests/fixtures/audio/silence.mp3 (1s, 18KB) + 2% realistic 15-45s via ffmpeg or padded
dataset.provider_subset: Mock MusicBrainz via e2e/mock_provider_server.py, ~500 tracks tagged E2E Track for deterministic matching

muzilla_rss_mib_peak.description: Muzilla-owned RSS peak during scan/matching (container cgroup memory.usage_in_bytes + host RSS sampler, Docker Engine excluded)

sqlite_connections_max.description: Peak distinct FDs on DB file (proxy for pooled connections)

fd_count_max.description: Total open FDs for muzilla PID

cold_scan_throughput_tracks_per_sec.description: Cold scan of 100k tracks; total duration / count, SSD baseline

incremental_scan_p95_ms.description: Scan after single file mtime bump, single-file scope

matching_p95_ms.description: Mock provider hydrate+rank per track batch

review_navigation_p95_ms.description: Inbox keyset pagination and detail fetch

apply_p95_ms_per_bundle.description: Apply 10-track ReviewBundle via API (journaled atomic replace)

undo_p95_ms.description: Undo same bundle, frozen inverse, reverse order

cancel_detection_ms.description: Cooperative cancel checkpoint latency for scan

playwright_apply_undo_success.description: Playwright web UI Apply then Undo succeeds (proof metadata/file path not CLI-only)

notes: Quantitative thresholds fixed before run and may not be relaxed afterward merely to obtain PASS. No hardware-independent total runtime required yet. Any target above 2 GiB requires evidence, bottleneck analysis, proposed new minimum, and documented trade-offs per production-readiness.md.
